caption:
Your loading bay door opens and closes more times a day than most things in the building.

Five things to look for on your next walk-through:
- It won't stay open on its own
- Scraping at the guides
- A bottom bar that lands crooked
- A motor that hums and strains
- Safety edges or photo-eyes that don't respond

See any of these around Miami's salty, humid air? Keep hands off the springs and call a trained tech before a small problem becomes a lost workday.

Full commercial roll-up door checklist at 305doors.com. Link in bio.
